---
title: "NYC Restaurant Inspections Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
    source_code: embed
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)
```

```{r}
data("rest_inspec")
```

```{r}
nyc_restaurants =
  rest_inspec |>
  select(
    camis, dba, boro, cuisine_description,
    inspection_date, score, grade,
    grade_date, latitude, longitude
  ) |>
  filter(
    boro %in% c("Manhattan", "Brooklyn", "Queens",
                "Bronx", "Staten Island"),
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")
  ) |>
  distinct()
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Inspection Grades by Borough

```{r}
nyc_restaurants |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, grade, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  count(boro, grade) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~boro,
    y = ~n,
    color = ~grade,
    type = "bar",
    colors = c("#8E6BBE", "#F2C94C", "#E89AB3")
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = "Restaurant Inspection Grades Across NYC",
    xaxis = list(title = "Borough"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Inspections"),
    barmode = "stack"
  )
```
